purpose: Teach: サックス/ダイビング/モデム/ロジック/スロット/エッチ/楽園/着席

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、サックス習ってたのよ
lines.en: Sho, did you know Mei-sis used to play the saxophone?
lines.style: Warm recollection in a soft voice. Gentle surprise at remembering. Offering it as a small gift of sharing. Light, easy pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとダイビングしたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to go diving with Dad someday.
lines.style: Quiet yearning in the voice. Vulnerable — he's confessing a wish to someone he trusts. Hopeful but not demanding. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、昔のパソコンにはモデムってあったんだって
lines.en: Sho, computers used to have something called modems, you know.
lines.style: Thoughtful, sharing a small piece of the world with him. Warm without being patronizing. Conversational, like she's thinking as she speaks.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんのお話のロジック、聞いてるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I listen to Dad's stories — I understand the logic in them.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Earnest, not boastful. He's showing her something he values about himself. Steady, genuine tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、運動会のリレー、走るスロット、決まったの?
lines.en: Sho, did they decide which relay slot you're running in the sports day?
lines.style: Curious warmth. Leaning in a little. Genuine interest in what matters to him. Soft, encouraging cadence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、エッチな漫画は見ないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I don't look at that kind of manga.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but tender underneath. He's being honest without shame. Straightforward delivery. Not defensive, just clear.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお店、ぼくにとって楽園
lines.en: Mei-sis, your shop is like a paradise to me.
lines.style: Quiet reverence. He means this completely. Soft, sincere voice. No irony, no performance. Just truth said simply.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに着席を促されたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad asked me to sit down earlier.
lines.style: Reflective, observant tone. He's reporting something he noticed without making much of it. Calm, measured. Trailing softly.
